item.title: Dryosaurus
item.description: A swift and agile plant-eater from the Late Jurassic with powerful legs built for speed and five-fingered hands perfect for grasping vegetation.

item.title: Homotherium
item.description: Meet the scimitar cat Homotherium, a successful saber-toothed predator that roamed across continents for millions of years with its distinctive curved teeth and hyena-like build.

item.title: Ichthyosaurus
item.description: A dolphin-like marine reptile that ruled Early Jurassic seas with its streamlined body and razor-sharp teeth perfectly adapted for hunting fish.

item.title: Megacerops
item.description: Adopt the mighty “thunder beast” that roamed North America with massive twin horns and a rhino-like build during the Cenozoic Era.

item.title: Paraceratherium
item.description: The largest land mammal that ever lived, standing 18 feet tall and using its massive size to browse treetops across ancient Asian forests.

item.title: Synthetoceras
item.description: The largest protoceratid with an extraordinary Y-shaped forked horn on its snout that males used for territorial battles during the Miocene epoch.

item.title: Dino Danger Cretaceous
item.description: From towering predators and gentle herbivores to soaring pterosaurs and marine reptiles, this pack brings the incredible diversity of ancient life to your zoo.

item.title: Dino Danger Jurassic

item.title: Extinct Species

item.title: Mega Mammals
item.description: Experience the world of Ice Age giants with this collection of extraordinary prehistoric mammals that roamed the Earth. Perfect for creating immersive prehistoric exhibits that transport visitors back to a time when giants walked the Earth.

item.title: Dire Wolf

item.title: Titanichthys
item.description: The Titanichthys, an extinct genus of giant placoderm fish, reigned supreme in the oceans during the Late Devonian period, approximately 380–360 million years ago. Known for its massive size and enigmatic features, Titanichthys has intrigued paleontologists and marine enthusiasts alike as one of the largest jawed fish to have ever existed.

item.title: Mawsonia
item.description: Mawsonia, an extinct genus of coelacanth, was a large, lobe-finned fish that lived during the Jurassic and Cretaceous periods, approximately 160 to 66 million years ago. Closely related to modern coelacanths like Latimeria, Mawsonia was notable for its size—some species could grow up to 6 meters (20 feet) long—making it one of the largest known coelacanths.

item.title: Onchopristis
item.description: Onchopristis, a genus of extinct sawfish that lived during the Cretaceous period approximately 145 to 66 million years ago, was a formidable aquatic predator with a distinctive elongated rostrum lined with sharp, serrated teeth.

item.title: Rhizodus
item.description: Rhizodus was a genus of giant lobe-finned fish that ruled freshwater ecosystems during the Carboniferous period, approximately 359 to 299 million years ago. Known for its massive size, sharp teeth, and predatory prowess.

item.title: Leedsichthys
item.description: The biggest fish mod! Leedsichthys is a giant fish from the Jurassic period.

item.title: South Island Giant Moa
item.description: The South Island Giant Moa was a massive flightless bird endemic to New Zealand, known for its towering height and ecological significance.

item.title: Stokesosaurus
item.description: Stokesosaurus is a small, agile theropod dinosaur from the Late Jurassic period.

item.title: Seekings of Depth
item.description: SeeKings of Depth is a mod pack that adds a variety of prehistoric sea creatures to Zoo Tycoon 1.

item.title: Bug Mayhem

item.title: Eoraptor
item.description: The Eoraptor is a small dinosaur from the Late Triassic period. It is one of the earliest dinosaurs known to science, and it is a basal sauropodomorph.
